Automation: Rules reference · resolve effects at the table

You send word through the people who owe you a favor, the people who fear you, and the people who simply like to talk.

Rules

Action
Passive
Attribute
None (no roll)
Target / range / shape
Self; one question about a person, place, faction or event your network or research could plausibly know.
Duration
The answer and contact remain known.
Equipment / acquisition
None.
Limits
Once per scene; one question.
Type
Utility

Ask one question. The DA answers truthfully from what that network would know. The answer may be incomplete or point to a source. You also learn who can tell you more.

Additional rulings
